label: Rigidity is persistence plus accessible uniqueness of concrete GOD_4
meaning: Premise-free certified difference (#1598). Rigidity gives persistence (persists_of_rigid) and accessible uniqueness: any two concrete GOD_4 at an accessible world both equal the one at w. Conversely, persistence puts the concrete GOD_4 x at w at every accessible world where some concrete GOD_4 y exists, where x is again a concrete GOD_4. The difference then identifies y with x.
